source.check: the Tyrone rural nominations report read in the Belfast News-Letter of 20 May 1964.

note: Triennial election of Dungannon Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. There was no contest: all thirteen outgoing Unionists were returned unopposed, and six Nationalists were nominated, one for each Nationalist division (Irish News, 20 May 1964, p. 7, which lists every nomination under the headings 'Nationalist nominations' and 'Unionist nominations'; the labels are those headings). All nineteen divisions are recorded. Returned unopposed in place of Mr. John Harvey, who did not seek re-election. Returned unopposed.
